text: Kasol & Kheerganga weekend 🌲 Fri night to Mon morning. Departure Dec 5: ₹18,999 for a group of 4, or ₹4,999 per person. Volvo from Delhi, camps, bonfire, trek guide. Dinner & breakfast included.
notes: A group price next to the date: 18 Dec must not be grounded by ₹18,999. The duration is described, not stated as days or nights.
